author: Haven
description: Hestia™ is a fast, elegant smart home dashboard for Hubitat Elevation. Responsive across desktop, tablet, and mobile. Lights, dimmers, color bulbs, fans, blinds, thermostats, locks, and security — all your devices, all your rooms, at a glance. Includes Artemis™ security module with full HSM integration, Ring sensor support, zone awareness, and armed status indicators. No cloud. No subscription. Your safe haven.
